meaning:
§ Merom = "high place"
the lake in northern Canaan at which Joshua routed the northern confederacy headed by Jabin
1a) site uncertain; probably the lake formed by the Jordan river about 10 miles (16 km) north of the Sea of Galilee

elsewhere.note: All these kings met together; and they came and encamped together at the waters of Merom, to fight with Israel.
